scope: 74 newly recognized components (45 attacks, 20 Trainers, 9 Abilities) and 58 fully supported additional cards; no previous supported program or metadata changes.

sources.title: Super Scoop Up
sources.checkedFacts: Resolve the coin first; on heads select a Pokemon and return its evolution stack and attachments.

sources.title: Noivern ex
sources.checkedFacts: Opponent cannot play Special Energy or Stadiums from hand during the next turn; Basic Energy and non-hand attachment remain available.

sources.title: Wailord Water Veil
sources.checkedFacts: Attachment from the owner's hand to this host cures every Special Condition; other source zones do not trigger it.

sources.title: Life Herb official translation
sources.checkedFacts: A successful coin permits one chosen Pokemon to receive both the 60-point heal and condition removal.

sources.title: Galarian Zapdos V
sources.checkedFacts: Special Energy discard precedes the attack's 170 damage.

sources.title: Pokemon Fan Club
sources.checkedFacts: Private deck search has a maximum of two Basic Pokemon, followed by reveal, hand placement and shuffle.

sources.title: Copycat official carddex

boundaries: 58 additional complete cards; 74 components; no previous supported program or metadata changes.
Energy damage counts supplied units, not physical cards, and excludes the opponent field.
Return chooses after a successful coin and moves the full physical stack; tails has no selection.
Hand attachment cure requires the owner's hand and the actual attached host; suppression and other source zones are respected.
Shared heal/cure uses one bound target. Only the Active Pokemon can carry Special Conditions.
Ancient Traits are not treated as Abilities. Three partial-card drafts exist only in test resources.
